Nice to meet you.

I was attracted to your illustrations from an article about the creation of a game, and I would like to request an illustration from you.

I would like to request an illustration in the style of PC98.
Please excuse the following bullet points about the contents of my request.

The character is "Rokujo Miyaho" from "A Promise in the Blue Sky.
The background is a nighttime scene with luminous insects smiling at us on the shining sea (Ref. 06).
Pose: hands clasped behind her back, bending slightly forward
She is wearing a swimsuit and, if possible, a school uniform (barefoot) (Ref. 01~05).

We are very sorry for your busy schedule.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

Hi Chipshi, nice to meet you!
If you don't mind, could you please draw Harumi Kono (HMX-17b Milpha) from "ToHeart2"?

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bYc6sZoLIvuGIGjCaWPUgDoVd70-yFxQ?usp=sharing
Like the image in the link, she is sitting on a chair with a charging cable connected to her wrist (since she is a robot) and she is sleeping while charging.
*The composition does not have to be the same.

The charging cable is connected to a stuffed bear-shaped mobile battery, which he recently received as a gift.

The expression on the face should be calm, as if she is having a pleasant dream.
(If you can make a difference, please give her a slightly panicked expression after she wakes up from sleep.)

We will leave the design of clothing (other than uniforms), batteries, chairs, etc. to you.
The drawing should be in PC98 style.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

This is the first time for me to meet you.
I would like to make a request for a dot illustration of an original character.

Outline
Dot illustration in the style of a PC98 novel game screen, please.
I would like to use a horror story style. The character is standing in a back alley at night, bathed in blood and staring at the screen (the viewer's side).
　The scene is the first encounter between the hero (the viewer), an ordinary person, and one of the heroines, an original character.
　(If it is difficult to depict the returning blood, you can leave it out.)
(If it is difficult to depict the blood on the victim's face, it can be done without it. If the character has a weapon, a knife should be used.
We would like you to use the main character's monologue or a sentence in the text field. We do not accept dialogue from the original character.
We will leave all other questions to you.

Ori-Chara
Please refer to the reference URL for the appearance.
She is an elementary school girl (9 years old) with a cold and vague atmosphere. She is about 130cm tall and has a slender impression.
She is a living dead person with amnesia, and although she is taciturn and expressionless, she has a simple and kind-hearted personality inside.
She fights against monsters and other strange creatures on a daily basis with her magical eye, which allows her to perceive the world with a sense of time that is stretched out as if she were on the verge of death, and with her exceptional knife fighting skills.

Image dialogues (please use them only as a reference for understanding the character)
...... I am Lumelie. Nice to meet you."
......, I understand. I'll do my best.
...... well, that's good.
...... are you okay? etc.

[Reference URL
https://tw6.jp/gallery/?id=197551(Full body view)
https://tw6.jp/character/illust?character_id=f23530(Other illustrations)
https://tw6.jp/character/status/f23530(Profile)

Usage
Personal viewing
Reference image at the time of request
Secondary distribution for non-commercial use (sharing with acquaintances)

We will leave all uncertainties to you.
We appreciate your consideration.
